product.ta-10-1.summary: The TA 10/1 brought invoicing calculations to a typewriter workstation.
product.ta-10-1.history: It was the invoicing machine in the range Triumph-Adler presented in 1971 for small and medium-sized businesses. Its electronics were in a separate case from the keyboard and print mechanism.
product.ta-10-1.technical.configuration: The program was fixed in the case. One surviving unit has diode-matrix boards. The programming manual also documents a PROM configuration.
product.ta-10-1.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-10-1.technical.limitations: The program from an identified unit and an operating test remain pending.
